references.text: God gave water from the rock to quench Israel's thirst in the wilderness, just as he opened the rock at Lehi to give Samson water.
Moses struck the rock and water flowed out for the people, a similar miraculous water supply as when God opened the rock for Samson.
The psalm describes how God split rocks in the wilderness and provided abundant water, which recalls God's intervention for Samson.
God turns the desert into springs of water, reflecting his ability to provide water in dry places, as at Lehi.
Isaiah refers to how God let water flow from the rock for his people, a parallel to the water miracle in Judges.
The preceding verse where Samson cries out to the Lord in his thirst, and God answers by giving him water.
Paul speaks of the spiritual rock that gave water to the Israelites, linking the water miracles to Christ.
